dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, can you explain this slide again? I'm not sure I understand the numbers.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən juː ɪkˈspleɪn ðɪs ˈslaɪd əˈɡɛn? aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈʃʊr aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd ðə ˈnʌmbərz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. On average, students now watch six English videos a week. That's twice as many as in 2020.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ɑːn ˈævərɪdʒ, ˈstuːdənts ˈnaʊ ˈwɑːtʃ ˈsɪks ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈvɪdioʊz ə ˈwiːk. ðæts ˈtwaɪs əz ˈmɛni əz ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈtwɛnti.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Twice as many? Where does the 2020 figure come from?
dialogue.reading: ˈtwaɪs əz ˈmɛni? ˈwɛr dʌz ðə ˈtwɛnti ˈtwɛnti ˈfɪɡjər ˈkʌm ˈfrʌm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: From a survey by another university. Students also use English apps three times more than before.
dialogue.reading: frəm ə ˈsɜːrveɪ baɪ əˈnʌðər ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti. ˈstuːdənts ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈjuːz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈæps ˈθriː ˈtaɪmz ˈmɔːr ðən bɪˈfɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Interesting. And what proportion of students speak English every day?
dialogue.reading: ˈɪntrəstɪŋ. ənd ˈwʌt prəˈpɔːrʃən əv ˈstuːdənts ˈspiːk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Only a small minority, about 9%. That's half as many as I expected.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli ə ˈsmɔːl maɪˈnɔːrəti, əˈbaʊt ˈnaɪn pərˈsɛnt. ðæts ˈhæf əz ˈmɛni əz aɪ ɪkˈspɛktɪd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: ˈhæf? soʊ juː ɪkˈspɛktɪd əˈbaʊt ˌeɪˈtiːn pərˈsɛnt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. But I estimate that the real number is a bit higher, because some students use English at work.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. bʌt aɪ ˈɛstəmeɪt ðæt ðə ˈriːəl ˈnʌmbər ɪz ə ˈbɪt ˈhaɪər, bɪˈkɔːz sʌm ˈstuːdənts ˈjuːz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ət ˈwɜːrk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And has that proportion changed since 2020?
dialogue.reading: ənd hæz ðæt prəˈpɔːrʃən ˈtʃeɪndʒd sɪns ˈtwɛnti ˈtwɛnti?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it has tripled. In 2020, it was only 3%.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪt hæz ˈtrɪpəld. ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈtwɛnti, ɪt wʌz ˈoʊnli ˈθriː pərˈsɛnt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's good news! Make sure the audience sees that clearly.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡʊd ˈnuːz! ˈmeɪk ˈʃʊr ði ˈɔːdiəns ˈsiːz ðæt ˈklɪrli.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You're right. I'll put it on a slide of its own.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈraɪt. aɪl ˈpʊt ɪt ɑːn ə ˈslaɪd əv ɪts ˈoʊn.
